# Assemble

> > Assemble is a project management and collaboration platform designed for creative teams, offering production planning tools, templates, and resources for film, video, and podcast creators.

The site features Assemble Magazine with comprehensive guides on filmmaking workflows, production roles, and distribution strategies, alongside a template library for pre-production planning, daily reports, and content marketing. Resources cover everything from shooting schedules and location scouting to strategic frameworks like Amazon's PR/FAQ template.

## Key Topics

- Pre-production planning
- Film production workflows
- Video production management
- Production templates and checklists
- Film distribution and festivals
- Production roles and crew hierarchy
- Location scouting
- Podcast planning and marketing
- Shooting schedules and call sheets
- Daily production reports
- Electronic press kits (EPK)
- Project management for creative teams
- Content distribution strategy
- Statement of Work (SOW)
- Film equipment management

## Production Planning & Workflows

- [How to Make a Shooting Schedule | A Step-By-Step Guide](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/how-to-make-a-shooting-schedule): Step-by-step guide to creating film shooting schedules & call sheets
- [Location Scouting Template](https://www.onassemble.com/template-library/location-scouting-template): Film location scouting checklist and template for pre-production
- [Daily Production Report Template](https://www.onassemble.com/template-library/daily-production-report-template): Daily production report template for tracking film progress & expenses
- [Film Equipment List Template](https://www.onassemble.com/template-library/film-equipment-list-template): Film equipment tracking template for production gear management
- [Best Project Management Collaboration Tools for Video Production](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/best-project-management-collaboration-tools-for-video-production): Video production tools comparison: Frame.io, Google Calendar & more

## Production Roles & Responsibilities

- [The Role of the Second Unit Director in Film](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/the-role-of-the-second-unit-director-in-film): Second unit director roles & responsibilities in film production
- [What Is an Associate Producer & What Do They Do?](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/what-does-an-associate-producer-do): Associate producer roles, responsibilities & crew hierarchy guide

## Distribution & Marketing

- [The ShortsTV Guide to Short Film Distribution](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/shortstv-guide-short-film-distribution): ShortsTV exec shares short film distribution & festival strategies
- [What is an EPK (Electronic Press Kit) for Filmmakers](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/what-is-an-epk-electronic-press-kit-for-filmmakers): EPK creation guide for filmmakers covering press materials & standards
- [Distribution](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/distribution): Distribution guides covering ShortsTV, SXSW & content strategy

## Podcast Production

- [Podcast Planning Template](https://www.onassemble.com/template-library/podcast-planning-template): Podcast planning template with calendar, research & script templates
- [Podcast Marketing Plan Template and Tips](https://www.onassemble.com/template-library/podcast-marketing-plan-template-and-tips): Podcast marketing plan template for promotion & audience building

## Business & Strategic Planning

- [Working Backwards: Amazon's PR/FAQ Template](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/working-backwards-amazon-s-pr-faq-template): Amazon's PR/FAQ framework with free Assemble template for startups
- [Statement of Work Template That Drives Real Execution](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/statement-of-work-template-that-drives-real-execution-assemble): SOW template guide for scope definition & team alignment in Assemble
- [SWOT Analysis Template and Competitive Landscape Guide for Strategic Clarity](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/swot-analysis-template-and-competitive-landscape-guide-for-strategic-clarity): Free SWOT analysis & competitive landscape templates for strategy
- [Sales Forecasting Template for ARR and Pipeline Planning](https://www.onassemble.com/blog/sales-forecasting-template-for-arr-and-pipeline-planning): Sales forecasting template for ARR planning & pipeline management
